verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking-and-relevance guide has dedicated sections on ranking by relevance plus popularity and by relevance plus recency. It also covers boosting and burying record sets, merchandising (promoting or hiding results) and text-match scoring, and a community user praised the compact sort_by syntax for custom sort signals. One critic said it has fewer tuning knobs than Lucene/Elasticsearch, but that is general skepticism rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence only. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of margin or arbitrary business-signal ranking, in-depth docs content beyond section headings, and independent hands-on corroboration of popularity/recency ranking.
